h: Following Torah Judgment Makes the Land an Enduring Gift

p: which Hashem your God gives you,
and possess it and dwell in it" (Devarim 17:14).
"Do the mitzvah stated in the passage,
in reward for which you will enter the Land
אֲשֶׁר ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ נוֹתֵן לָךְ בִּזְכוּתְךָ
which Hashem your God gives you — in your merit;
'and possess it and dwell in it'
in reward for possessing you will dwell."
Although it speaks of entering the Land,
and Yehoshua had already been appointed
But we have already said in explanation of
that is, the Name Havayah is the Giver,
and then all the kelipos are nullified,
which will be in the days of Mashiach,
עַל יְדֵי חַרְבָּא דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
through the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He.
And this is what it said: "Do the mitzvah," etc.,
"in reward for which you will enter the Land
אֲשֶׁר ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ נוֹתֵן לָךְ בִּזְכוּתְךָ
which Hashem your God gives you — in your merit":
that you merit the holiness of the Land
they were driven from the Land,
they will merit an inheritance that has no interruption.
of which it said "stated in the passage"?
To say that it refers to the mitzvah of the king
that is not so much a merit;
when they asked for a king,
it was reckoned to them as a sin.
But it seems that it refers
"If a matter be too hard for you," etc.,
"then you shall arise and go up," etc.;
that there, in the Beis HaMikdash,
for from it Torah goes forth to all of Yisrael
"For out of Tzion shall go forth Torah,
and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim";
"the word of Hashem" — this is halachah.
And three things are stated there in the pasuk:
בֵּין דָּם לְדָם בֵּין דִּין לְדִין
"between blood and blood, between judgment and judgment,
and they, one opposite the other,
correspond to the holiness of the three Avos,
who are the root of life
the opposite of the three kelipos
that take a person out of the world.
between the blood of niddah and the blood of zivah
and the blood of a woman after childbirth;
and this corresponds to the kelipah of lust,
which is the kelipah of Yishmael,
the refuse of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was the root of love,
corresponds to the kelipah of jealousy,
שֶׁהוּא הַפְּסוֹלֶת מִיִּצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which is the refuse of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was the root of fear
corresponds to the kelipah of idolatry,
and it is the first of kelipah,
And the metzora is sent outside the three camps;
that is, he goes out from the community of all of Yisrael,
who have a share in the World to Come;
that he has no share in the World to Come.
is the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who merited that his bed was complete,
so that there is no refuse at all in Yisrael.
And likewise the Sifrei lists afterward:
this is the giving of the water to the sotah,
the breaking of the heifer's neck,
and the purification of the metzora."
The giving of the water to the sotah
corresponds to the kelipah of lust;
and the breaking of the heifer's neck
to the kelipah of jealousy and murder;
the holiness of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him
And the purification of the metzora
כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
עַל שֵׁם כִּי שָׂרִיתָ עִם אֱלֹהִים וְגוֹמֵר
because "you have striven with God," etc.
which was for the sake of his offspring,
that in the end they will all be purified,
so that they will be included in
"And your people shall all be righteous";
who was like Adam HaRishon before the corruption
and knew nothing at all of the evil inclination,
did not need the name Yisrael
And on Shabbos one merits the holiness of the Avos,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
"Shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the daughter is crowned with them."
And through the mitzvah stated in the passage (Devarim 17:10):
וְעָשִׂיתָ עַל פִּי הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּידוּ לְךָ
"And you shall do according to the word that they tell you"
in reward for it you will enter the Land,
that the holiness of the Land be fixed in you
And this is what it said:
אֲשֶׁר הוי״ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נוֹתֵן לָךְ בִּזְכוּתְךָ
"which Havayah your God gives you — in your merit,
כִּירוּשָּׁה שֶׁאֵין לָהּ הֶפְסֵק לְעוֹלְמֵי עַד
like an inheritance that has no interruption, forever;
for in the end Yisrael will be purified,
וְעַל יְדֵי חַרְבָּא דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
and through the sword of the Holy One, blessed be He,
all the kelipos will be nullified,
and the evil inclination will be nullified.
